## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Look at `src/sync.ts` and `docs/guide.md` and nothing outside the repo. Do not change any file.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
files.jitso/jitso.yaml:
# JITSO allowlists (ADR-0027). A build, and any override a launch asks for,
# may name only what is listed here. `cli/jitso/catalog.test.ts` asserts that every
# entry exists in this repo: skills under `.agents/skills/`, MCP servers in
# `.mcp.json`, Sonnet/Opus ids in `.agents/project.yaml` (`orchestration:`).
# Models are full ids, never aliases.
version: 1

models:
  - claude-haiku-5-5
  - "{{model}}"
  - claude-sonnet-5-5
  - claude-opus-5-5

efforts: [low, medium, high]

mcp: [dbhub, openapi]

skills:
  - sprint-testing
  - shift-left-testing
  - test-automation
  - framework-development
  - exploratory-testing
  - orca-orchestration

tools: [Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, Write, Edit]

# Patterns of the fields a build may require, each matched against the whole value.
fields:
  ticket_key: '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*-[0-9]+$'
  env: '^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$'
